narr: A cold front supported scattered heavy rain-producing thunderstorms across Northeastern Pennsylvania. Multiple storms moved very slowly over the same townships of Lackawanna, Wayne and Pike counties. A very small area of 3 to 5 inches of rainfall triggered flooding of roads and a local business.
ev: Flowing water along with rock, mud and gravel debris was reported on several roadways.
The county 911 dispatch reported flooded roadways in this area.
County dispatch reported a foot of water flowing across Catterson Road.

Roads in the area were washed over with considerable amounts of mud and rock debris. A nearby restaurant was heavily damaged by flood waters. Water and mud were reported to be a few feet deep inside the business.
